subject: Next step: technical deep dive (ML/infra) — aligning attendees & slots
messages:
From: Alex Ball <alex.ball@edgehealth.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeHealth discovery follow-up — propose technical deep dive

Thanks for the call today, Neha — really helpful to get a sense of Redwood's serving runtime and the autoscaling approach. Quick recap and next step request: we'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where our ML infra and platform engineers can walk through our model footprint and ask detailed questions about batching, quantization, and private deployment options.

Brief ask: can you share 3 potential time slots (we're US-based, PST) and a short agenda so we can confirm internal attendees? We expect to have: Sarah Ong (platform lead), Drew Lim (ML infra), and one of our SREs.

Proposed agenda (from our side):
- 10m: intros & objectives
- 30–45m: model serving architecture deep dive (your runtime + KV cache / batching)
- 15–25m: capacity estimates & deployment options (dedicated vs private)
- 10m: next steps / action items

I've attached our discovery notes and a tentative attendee list for your reference (attachment: edgehealth-attendee-list.xlsx).

Thanks — Alex
EdgeHealth | Senior PM
alex.ball@edgehealth.ai

--

Alex — thanks for the clear agenda. Looping in Priyom (solutions eng) and Ben (CS lead) so we have the right folks on the call. A few quick items from our side before we lock a slot: 

1) Scope priority — please tell us whether the highest priority is (A) reducing per-token cost, (B) latency SLOs for 95th percentile, or (C) simplifying private deployment. We'll tailor the deck to focus on the right levers.

2) Attendee matrix — can you confirm which of Sarah/Drew/SRE will be decision-makers vs technical contributors? Helpful for us when structuring the runbook section.

3) Logistics — we prefer a 75-minute window (fits our runbook demo plus Q&A). Below are times we have open (all PST):
- Tue 09 Mar, 10:00–11:15
- Tue 09 Mar, 13:30–14:45
- Wed 10 Mar, 08:30–09:45

If none work, suggest two of your preferred options and we will prioritize. I'll also drop a shared Drive pre-read with the runtime overview and a short inference checklist (expect a 1–2 page ask list).
